title: Strategic Disclosure & Open-Source Timing
description: Strategic framing for when to disclose or open-source trade secrets: the exclusion-value vs. diffusion-value tradeoff. Covered key timing tests (complement vs. moat, half-life, execution asymmetry) and examples (Tesla, Kubernetes, Llama, Xerox). Heuristic: open what commoditizes, guard what compounds.

title: Where to Keep Your Secrets — Paper vs Digital
description: A two-part deep-dive covering a decision checklist for paper vs encrypted digital storage based on adversary type, then physical concealment strategy against insiders — layered defense with decoys, tamper-evidence, and off-site tiers.

title: Free Stuff Apps Research: Finding Free Furniture, Filing Cabinets & More
description: Deep web research compiling the best apps and platforms for finding free items people are giving away — from dedicated freebie apps like Trash Nothing and Freebie Alerts to marketplace free sections. Covers strategy for scoring specific items like filing cabinets, desks, and furniture without spending money.

title: Context-bloat analysis for grill-me-v2 JSON artifact
description: Designed and drafted the grill-me-v2 skill (JSON-logging grilling with handoff bridge) from 11 prior design decisions. Ended with context-bloat analysis for small-model pickup agents, identifying three mechanical mitigations — rigid question template, answer normalization, and docs-first rule — to apply when we resume.

title: Grill Session: Markdown Doc Skills — Part 2
description: Continuing the grill session on the four open design questions from the markdown-doc-skills-research handoff (03-14-2026): meta-skill router invocation (resolved: auto-detect), quick-reference skill scope, retrofitting existing skills, and build priority order.

title: The End of Trade Secrets: What Becomes Valuable When AI Decrypts Everything
description:
Exploration of the endgame where AI can decrypt and perfectly replicate any professional's formula or trade secret — collapsing the value of knowledge-based work. Discussion of "state" (attention, trust, capital, atoms) as the only durable moat, and an exhaustive taxonomy of skills that survive before, during, and after the destabilization.
Note: There are other related sessions that go into other interesting concepts related to this as well.

title: Paper Strategies for Growing Reference Documents
description: Exploration of strategies for writing paper documents (architectures, frameworks, formulas) that accumulate new sub-headers over time — covering margin reserves, decimal numbering, overflow additions, and loose-leaf as alternatives to full rewrites.

title: Research: Hit Song Methodologies from Billboard-Verified Artists
description: Web research into Billboard-charting artists who have published repeatable hit-making methodologies, frameworks, and workflows. Compiled findings across three tiers, from Max Martin's Melodic Math system and Charlie Puth's production class to philosophical approaches like Rick Rubin's The Creative Act.

title: Fixed pi-subagents `agentContract` schema causing Gemini INVALID_ARGUMENT 400
description: Diagnosed a Gemini 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT error caused by pi-subagents' AgentContractOverride.version using an integer-typed enum (unsupported by Gemini's function-declaration validator). Applied a local patch to schemas.ts replacing enum:[1] with minimum:1/maximum:1, preserving runtime validation while restoring Gemini compatibility.

title: grill-me-v3: decision-tree triage to fix endless grilling sessions
description: Diagnosed grill-me-v2's 43-question bloat (70% rubber-stamp answers) and created grill-me-v3 with an internal decision-tree build step that classifies branches as needs-user or self-resolved before grilling. Patched two gaps: logging self-resolved decisions into the handoff JSON artifact, and a contradiction rule when user answers invalidate earlier stated decisions.

title: Meta-skill improvement framework: two-tier maintenance model for 32-agent-skill fleet
description: Reviewed the write-a-skill-v2 meta-skill against the Agent Skills spec, Anthropic's official skill-creator, and the skill-linter tool. Designed a two-tier skill-fleet maintenance model: monthly automated lint sweeps across all 32 skills and quarterly deep-improvement sessions on high-use or flagged skills only, avoiding the costly one-by-one approach. Identified 8 concrete improvements to write-a-skill-v2 ranked by leverage — a missing validator script, the author/improve job split, security gap, and cross-platform triggering fix among them.

title: Daily AI/Developer Trends Report Skill — Requirements and Deduplication Rules
description: Designed an explicitly invoked skill for deep daily research into AI and development trends, with primary-source evidence, a rolling 24-hour preference and 7-day maximum, semantic deduplication against the previous three reports, and quality-over-quota selection. Reports will be medium-length Markdown briefings with date-based filenames under b0ttsagent/reports/daily-reports/AI-Development Trends, and the skill will disable automatic model invocation.

description: Brainstormed 10 candidate skills for the stack, then designed and authored markdown-doc-designs — a dual-mode (silent pre-write advisory + manual findings report with offered diff) Markdown quality skill grounded in the 08-01-2026 research artifact. Followed the write-a-skill-v2 + karpathy workflow; all checklist items verified.

title: Broad AGENTS.md Research and Resource Review
description: Conducted broad research on AGENTS.md as a general repository instruction format, prioritizing reputable official documentation, practical examples, Agent Skills resources, tool interoperability, and empirical studies. Created the in-depth report at b0ttsagent/Notes/Research/AGENTS-md-research-report.md without modifying the root AGENTS.md.

title: Getting Agents to Write in My Style: Research & Skill Plan
description: Researched how people get AI agents to follow personal code style (rule files, StyLua/Selene tooling, passive learning tools like cc-habits). Designed a workflow to extract the user's Luau style conventions into a style-guide spec and a potential restyle-luau skill — restyle by connected cluster, freeze public APIs, verify per cluster.

description: Deep web research into how verified top-charting artists (Billie Eilish/Finneas, Olivia Rodrigo/Dan Nigro, SZA, Kendrick Lamar, Taylor Swift, The Weeknd, Dua Lipa, Beyonce, Drake, J. Cole, Ryan Tedder, Max Martin, Harry Styles, Jack Antonoff) consistently write hits, focused on singing and lyric writing. Deliverable: 12 documented workflows with Billboard/Grammy evidence, cross-artist patterns, a synthesized singer-songwriter process, and a weekly training routine.

title: SLOBS Hotkey Stamp Logger — Design Grill
description: Brainstormed and grilled a design for a Windows app that logs Streamlabs OBS recording moments via two rebindable hotkeys (quick log / full log with description) into a JSON file, with an in-app session log viewer (edit/delete). Design settled: session-aware Python app using the SLOBS Remote API, shipped as a PyInstaller single-exe. Grill session log closed and ready for handoff.

title: Antigravity deep dive: agents, subagents, skills & model routing
description: Researched Google Antigravity (antigravity.google/docs) end to end: how agents/projects work, the .agents/ folder layout for custom subagents, skills, and rules, and native AGENTS.md support (since v1.20.3). Confirmed OpenRouter/BYOK/custom providers are NOT supported — only 6 offered models (plan-gated) plus tier-based subagent model frontmatter (inherit/flash/pro); flagged community proxy hacks as ToS violations.

title: Vocal Mixing Frameworks Research — Documented Chains of Verified Engineers
description: Deep web research via 5 parallel researcher subagents into documented vocal mixing/recording workflows of verified, mainstream-relevant (2021-2026) engineers and artists (Bainz, Kesha Lee, Teezio, Mike Dean, MixedByAli, Serban Ghenea, CLA, plus the new-wave/rage lane: Uzi, Carti, Yeat, Lucki, wifiskeleton), weighted ~70% hip-hop/pop. Delivered 35 evidence-cited case studies and 6 synthesis docs (comparison matrix, recurring patterns, universal chain translated to free tools, home-recording playbook, glossary, source library) to b0ttsagent/research/vocal-mixing-frameworks/. Also surfaced credit corrections (GNX = Oli Jacobs, Clancy = Adam Hawkins, MUSIC = Fritz Owens).

title: Dual-PC Capture Card Research — OBS Projector Quality Verdict
description: Researched the user's dual-PC streaming setup (gaming PC → VIXLW generic USB3 capture card → laptop encode, 1080p60) via 6 parallel researcher subagents (lanes: card chip, projector behavior, dedicated apps, source method, receive/encode settings, NDI). Verdict: OBS fullscreen projector is the correct near-lossless method and no specialized app beats it; the capture card (likely MacroSilicon MS2130/MS2131) is the real quality bottleneck. Delivered a quality-first action list: switch Display Capture→Game Capture, fix color-range mismatch, verify true USB3 port + YUY2/NV12 60fps, disable auto-exposure, NVENC CBR 6000/P6 settings, and Prefer-Maximum-Performance + restart-OBS fix for long-session FPS drops. NDI ruled out (not worth it, marginal gain erased by 4:2:0 stream encode). Briefs saved to b0ttsagent/temp/cc-research/.

title: AI Usage Aggregator Research: Track OpenCode Go, OpenRouter & DeepSeek
description: Researched AI-plan tracker apps (CrossUsage, QuotaMeter, etc.), the OpenCode Go plan (limits: $12/5h, $30/wk, $60/mo; no public usage API), and DeepSeek/OpenRouter usage endpoints. Verified via pi docs and OpenCode SDK types that both agents expose per-message hooks carrying provider/model/tokens/cost (pi message_end event; opencode message.updated plugin event), confirming a hook-based custom aggregator app is fully feasible.

description: Read the full grill-me-v3 skill (SKILL.md + scripts/append.js) and live-tested the append helper to ground every finding. title: AI Formula Decryption Endgame → Exclusive State & a Personalized Skill Roadmap
description: Deep speculative analysis of AI's ability to reverse-engineer every formula and trade secret — how the skill economy hyperinflates, value migrates from knowledge to exclusive state (attention, trust, capital, atoms, substrate), and who becomes valuable (substrate owners, attention owners, trust layer). Then a personalized skill roadmap grounded in the user's founder profile (Roblox dev, Whack Grass, trend-prediction superpower, perfect-pitch musician, 30-day free window before a part-time job): tiered skills, books, and a sprint plan.

title: Handling Public Reception as a Content Creator — Interactive Session
description: Explain-it-v2 teaching session (started via the explain-it-v2 skill) on handling public reception for content creators, using the user's real experience with Roblox dev videos (bunch of likes, 2 haters). Covered the three kinds of feedback (attack/critique/cheer), negativity bias and the plausibility filter, the Truth + Repeat gates, the action protocol (reply/delete/block, real-critique responses), how to tell critique from attack (tone isn't the test; extract kernel, toss verdict), and how to handle fake rumors people believe (witnesses vs copies). Session was mid-drill when the user logged it.
